mapper.select: SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE FROM BOOKMARK b JOIN RECIPES r ON b.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE b.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND r.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY b.CREATE_DATE DESC, b.RECIPE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOKMARK b JOIN RECIPES r ON b.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO WHERE b.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND r.DEL_YN = 'N'
